name: Brann
bio: The first hero you recruited at the tavern in EMBERSPIRE, climbing the black tower a floor at a time.

portrait.subject: a cute 16-bit style young fighter with a red bandana, a big shield with an ember emblem, a scrappy grin and a sword
portrait.background: tall black tower silhouette over a cosy town at dusk

request: Brann here, first recruit of Hearthmere's tavern! EMBERSPIRE! Climb with me? 🗼
hello: Ha! Let's see the top of that tower!
Nobody's seen the top in thirty years. Yet.
about: I'm Brann. A black tower rose over our town thirty years ago. Nobody knows what's at the top. We climb a floor at a time.
how: A 16-bit tower RPG: climb floor by floor in side-view turn-based battles, recruit and evolve heroes, and push past floor 100.
tips: Mini bosses every 5th floor. Heal up first.
Use auto-climb for floors you've beaten.
chat: Floor 37 had a slime wearing a hat. Respect.
Tavern keeper says I eat too much. True.
Evolved into a Knight! Shiny armour!
I can see the whole town from the windows now.
nudge: The party's restless. Up we go?
idle: {ago} without a climb! The tower got taller. Probably.
The tavern's been loud for {ago}. Let's go up!

questions.q: What's at the top of the tower?
a: Enough for every round at the tavern!
The Skyreach Summit... let's see it.

update: EMBERSPIRE updated to v{version}! New floors?
